Andrew Loder <q960...@musgrave.cqu.edu.au> writes:
>What is the highest amount of hand damage you can give a vampire (any
>vamp, your choice) using the fewest amount of cards?

How about 1+2*(X-3), where X is the number of cards (counting the vampire
card itself).

1 for a Tremere with potence (e.g. Ulugh Beg)
1 for a potence skill card
1 for The Ankara Citadel, Turkey
X-2 for Fists of Death, all at superior

If you're only counting Library cards, add a Ventrue and replace one
of the Fists with The Island of Yiaros for an extra point of strength
(since Ulugh has 3 votes).

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On 15 Nov 1999, L. Scott Johnson wrote:

> Andrew Loder <q960...@musgrave.cqu.edu.au> writes:
> >What is the highest amount of hand damage you can give a vampire (any
> >vamp, your choice) using the fewest amount of cards?
>
> How about 1+2*(X-3), where X is the number of cards (counting the vampire
> card itself).
>
> 1 for a Tremere with potence (e.g. Ulugh Beg)
> 1 for a potence skill card
> 1 for The Ankara Citadel, Turkey
> X-2 for Fists of Death, all at superior

Poor, poor, if you're going for card intense amounts of hand damage.

Fire in the Blood (getting you +1 per round)
Trap, getting you lots of rounds.
Cailean, getting you POT and set range.
Increased Strength * (decksize - 3)
Growing Fury (at superior, Strike: +3 hand damage, not 1st round)

Growing Fury is a hand strike in this instance so Increased Strength will
add +2 hand damage to it, inheriting the properties of the base damage.

Trap the first round, And Fire in the blood getting you started.
Cailean continually sets range to long, so that both vampires wave at each
other.
On the 4th round, play 1 of your Increased Strengths
On the 7th round, play 1 of your Increased Strengths
And so on.

Assuming you have 87 Increased Strength, 87*3+1= 262nd round that you play
your final Increased Strength on. On the 265th round, combat would end
due to three rounds passing without combat cards being played, so on the
265th round, you strike with Growing Fury, after setting range to close.

1 base hand damage
+ 265 hand damage from Fire in the Blood
+ 174 hand damage from Increased Strength
+ 3 hand damage from Growing Fury
-----
443 hand damage total

I think.

--

James Coupe

OK, if you want to play that way, how about a hand strike for 85000.

(Approximate under DCI tournament rules)

Here's how I got there:
Fire in the blood is cumulative and Ankara Rocks!

Cailean gets Thaumaturgy and gets the Ankara
Cailean enters combat with Sammy
Sammy plays a trap and Cailean plays a fire in the blood
Cailean will continue to play fire in the blood's every third round
until he is out of cards.
Then Sammy starts playing Drawing out the Beasts every third round.
Then all the other players start playing Nosferatu Putrescence every
third round, that should get you over 85,000 hand damage.
Anyway. The proof is left as an excercise to the reader.

I have an Excel spreadsheet which works most of the math out.
